verdict.rationale: Docs describe latency-related features (predicted outputs, prompt caching reducing latency, priority tier for predictable access) and community reports confirm sub-second/fast response times in practice, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents a streaming (SSE/token-by-token) API parameter or provides concrete latency benchmarks tied to streaming behavior. missing for 10: explicit streaming API documentation (e.g., stream=true parameter), first-party latency/benchmark numbers, and confirmation that streaming works as described in hands-on tests.
